{{BossList|Ref = Only the first '''Undead Miner''' is a [[Boss]] enemy.|Default}} |legacy_base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]5,000 |legacy_speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (3.5) |legacy_defense = {{Defense}}20% |legacy_hidden = No |legacy_fly = No |legacy_ghost = No |legacy_lead = No |legacy_immunity = {{Attr|Stun}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Undead Miner''' is a large enemy that appears in [[Badlands II]]. It has high health and an average speed, with 40% defense. It has [[Stun Immunity]], meaning it only gets slowed down by stuns and it cannot be knocked back. When it debuts, it is a [[Boss]] enemy. ==Appearance== The '''Undead Miner''' is a large humanoid with a waist and lower arms in its rig. It has a green skin color and wears tattered dark brown overalls with yellow buttons and a buckle. It also has a brown shirt on its torso, under the overalls. It also has a dark brown helmet with an inactive lamp strapped to it. It wields a rusty pickaxe. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Engineer]] are very useful against this. *You can use towers like the [[Sledger]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Warden]] to slow this down. **Do also note that freezing towers and the [[Warden]] will slow down the '''Undead Miner''' for a shorter amount of time because of its large size. *You can use defense dropping towers, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]], to reduce its defense. *Splash damage towers, such as the [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]] can be useful against the '''Undead Miner''' as it normally spawn in groups during the later waves. **Additionally, splash damage towers ignores defense, making them even more effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseUndeadMiner.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} Bringonbringonericchoupomoting.png|'''Undead Miner''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} BadlandsPI3.jpg|'''Undead Miner''' on a promotional image. BadlandsPI4.jpg|'''Undead Miner''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator - Uhhhhh......?|'''Undead Miner''' in a promotional video. Tower Defense Simulator Roblox Trailer|'''Undead Miner''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- 🌵 BADLANDS Trailer! 🌵|'''Undead Miner''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexUndeadMiner.png|'''Undead Miner''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Undead Miner''' is a reference to the mining towns in the American Frontier, also popularly known as the Wild West. *In the promotional images for the [[v1.4.0|Wanted Dead Update]], the '''Undead Miner''' had its skull entirely exposed, but in-game its head is entirely green. Furthermore, it had a torn right sleeve, which does not appear in-game. ==Version History== *'''30 September 2022''' - [[v1.3.0]] **'''Undead Miner''' added. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **Energy immunity replaced with stun immunity. *'''5 February 2025''' - [[v1.52.0]] **Modern version added. ***None of the changes were applied to its legacy version. **Health decreased from 5,000 to 3,500. **Defense increased from 20% to 40%. **Speed decreased from Above Average (3.5) to Average (3). **Now gives {{Money|2,250}} every 50% health lost. **{{Bug}} Appears twice in the [[Index]], one of them not loading in any model for the preview. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer appears twice in the [[Index]]. ==Notes== {{Badlands|[[Withered]]|Wave 18|Undead Miner|Wave 20|[[Breaker]], [[Breaker3]] & [[Breaker4]]|Wave 21}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Late-Game]]
